title: Grokking horizon vs. OOD overtraining across training steps
question: Coordinate-free and zero-preamble setups (nope, include_alphabet=False) can require > 100k–400k steps to grok in-domain addition, whereas models that converge earlier can see zero-shot OOD base accuracy (B = 3, B = 12) peak around 75k–100k steps and then decay as training loss is driven to zero on the training bases {2, 4, 8, 10}. How do in-domain exact_match and zero-shot OOD base transfer evolve across checkpoints from 25k to 500k steps?
